name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 4 visits over 57 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.4 days starting 2026-01-12, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.61 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
